channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Reggie Miller | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Reggie Miller from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Al Harrington on Reggie Miller
item.description:
Al Harrington on Reggie Miller work ethic:

“Reggie Miller is probably the hardest workers that I’ve ever seen. And most superstitious player I’ve ever seen too. When I say he did the same thing the same way every single day. Like, he got to the gym at the same time every single day, he sat down the same way, he fu*king blew his nose I will never forget because I used to watch him he would take three napkins or three pieces of tissue and put it on his thigh like, one, two, three turn it fold it blow his nose throw it away. Put his socks on the same way at the same time on the clock every single day. Bro was amazing just to watch him.”

Al Harrington on Reggie Miller, Aug 20, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tyrese Haliburton on Reggie Miller
item.description:
Tyrese Haliburton on his Reggie Miller choke celebration:

“If I would’ve known it was a two, I would not have done it. I might have wasted it. If I do it again, people might say I'm aura farming. I don't plan on using it again.”

Tyrese Haliburton on Reggie Miller, May 22, 2025. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Spike Lee on Reggie Miller, John Starks
item.description:
Spike Lee:

“Game six. Indiana. Every time I see John Starks, I give him a hug, cuz he didn’t show up in Game 6. I would’ve had to move. That game—the next morning, I was on the cover of Newsday, the New York Post and New York Daily News. I was being blamed for the loss. And Reggie, people ask him, ‘Do you still hate Spike?’ People ask me, ‘You still hate Reggie?’ Like that sh— happened 20-something years ago. Nah, I got caught in the crossfire. Knicks vs. Pacers. That was war, man. That was real beef.”

Spike Lee on Reggie Miller, John Starks, Apr 18, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Chris Mullin on Reggie Miller
item.description:
Playing some of his career's best years alongside Reggie, Chris had the highest regard for the Pacers superstar's dedication to his routine.

“I always respected Reggie's work ethic, his routine, man he he did not vary, he did the same thing every day, so dedicated, great teammate….He carried that franchise for almost 20 years,”

Chris Mullin on Reggie Miller, Mar 28, 2025. Source: Basketball Network.

item.title: JJ Redick on Reggie Miller, Dalton Knecht
item.description:
Dave McMenamin:JJ Redick on Dalton Knecht:

“Reggie [Miller] and I were talking before the game and he was like, ‘It’s high praise to say he’s in the top 1% of shooters …’ Well, nah, he’s in the top 1%. … That was supernatural what he just did”

JJ Redick on Reggie Miller, Dalton Knecht, Oct 18, 2024. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: Spike Lee on Reggie Miller
item.description:
“There’s no rivalry between Reggie and I.It’s all love. Peace and love. Two grown Black men who respect each other.”

Spike Lee on Reggie Miller, May 6, 2024. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Mychal Thompson on LeBron James, Reggie Miller, John Stockton
item.description:
Mychal Thompson:

“We talk about it all the time. I say, ‘Look at LeBron James as an example.’ LeBron is going to be 39, but he has the body of a 29-year-old because of his workouts and his work ethic. Reggie Miller retired when he was 40. John Stockton, the same thing. There have been a bunch of guys that have played into their late 30s or close to 40 at a high level. Klay can do the same thing because his game translates into maturing well because he's a shooter. Shooters last a lot longer than guys that win dunk contests.”

Mychal Thompson on LeBron James, Reggie Miller, John Stockton, Aug 30, 2023. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Chad Buchanan on Reggie Miller, Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
Buchanan told Basketball News.

“We see him as hopefully being the next Reggie Miller. We had a Reggie Miller mural painted on a building in downtown Indianapolis, and I think our dream is that one day Tyrese will have [his own] up somewhere in downtown Indianapolis.”

Chad Buchanan on Reggie Miller, Tyrese Haliburton, Aug 19, 2022. Source: basketballnews.com.

item.title: James Harden on Kyle Korver, Reggie Miller
item.description:
“I think No. 1 is definitely going to be hard to catch. You've got the best shooter that ever touched a basketball in Steph. But that realm from Reggie to Ray to Kyle Korver [in fifth place], I mean, those are some unbelievable shooters that we all witnessed shoot the basketball at a high level.”

James Harden on Kyle Korver, Reggie Miller, Mar 11, 2022. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Steve Nash, Charles Barkley, Reggie Miller
item.description:
“It’s the nature of the ball not bouncing your way here or there, injuries, breaks, stuff like that. But perennially, a guy like CP, you want him on your team no matter what. He’s made every team he has been on competitive and better than they would be otherwise. However you calculate that or quantify that, it’s winning. You want to have the championships. “But nobody questions his ability to impact the game and to win at the highest level. The championship will probably be nice for him, but that’s not going to define him. You got guys like Charles Barkley, Steve Nash, Reggie Miller, a who’s who of Hall of Famers who haven’t won a championship. You understand how hard it is.”

Stephen Curry on Steve Nash, Charles Barkley, Reggie Miller, Jan 10, 2022. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: James Harden on Reggie Miller
item.description:
“Yeah, it was definitely that. Reggie is the one that got me going. He’s got me going for sure,”

James Harden on Reggie Miller, Dec 1, 2021. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Mychal Thompson on Karl Malone, Reggie Miller
item.description:
Drew Shiller:Mychal Thompson on Klay's high school recruitment:

“He was very skinny. He made Reggie Miller look like Karl Malone. That's how skinny Klay was in high school ... so a lot of the Pac-12 schools didn't really take him seriously.”

Mychal Thompson on Karl Malone, Reggie Miller, Mar 24, 2020. Source: Twitter @DrewShiller.

item.title: Klay Thompson on Ray Allen, Steve Kerr, Larry Bird, Reggie Miller
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Klay Thompson:

“What is somebody going to tell me about my jump shot that I can’t fix? Unless it’s Reggie Miller or Ray Allen, I don’t know who I’m supposed to listen to. Larry Bird? Steve Kerr. I’ll listen to Steve. Steve shot 45 percent.”

Klay Thompson on Ray Allen, Steve Kerr, Larry Bird, Reggie Miller, Dec 27, 2018. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Richard Jefferson on Mark Jackson, Chris Webber, Reggie Miller
item.description:
Jefferson told CBS Sports.

“I don't necessarily always watch basketball games to see what's going on with the basketball game. I watch basketball games to listen to how Mark Jackson speaks or Reggie Miller or Chris Webber. What can I take from them? Listening to their timing, figuring out what I would say and how I would say it in those moments. Very similar to a kid who's watching his favorite basketball player and then going out in the park and trying to emulate that move.”

Richard Jefferson on Mark Jackson, Chris Webber, Reggie Miller, Nov 19, 2018. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Reggie Miller
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Anthony Davis on playing in smallest city in #NBA:

“(People say) ‘You can’t win in a small market’ or ‘You don’t get noticed in a small market.’ But then you look at guys (like Reggie Miller in Indiana) and they won and have been well recognized with their respective teams.”

Anthony Davis on Reggie Miller, Apr 19, 2018. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Reggie Miller
item.description:
Carlisle:

“I think Reggie is a valid comparison. We just got to do everything we can to take advantage of him offensively and protect him on D.”

Rick Carlisle on Reggie Miller, Feb 22, 2018. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Bradley Beal on Reggie Miller
item.description:
More Beal on his historical accomplishment:

“At the same time, I always feel like I’ve got more to do so I want to continue to see how far I can get. Be up there with Reggie and Ray and all those guys who set the milestones for us guys nowadays.”

Bradley Beal on Reggie Miller, Nov 21, 2017. Source: Twitter @CandaceDBuckner.

item.title: Myles Turner on Reggie Miller
item.description:
Sirius XM NBA:Myles Turner on Reggie Miller:

“I have nothing but respect for Reggie & he is the greatest Pacer of all time”

Myles Turner on Reggie Miller, Jan 24, 2017. Source: Twitter @SiriusXMNBA.

item.title: Latrell Sprewell on Reggie Miller
item.description:
“He’ll just flop and I am like, ‘Stop flopping, man.’ You can’t touch him, he’s always at the free throw line. But you have to respect Reggie, he’s always running around screens, and if you left him open, he’s going to knock down shots. You just have to be careful how you guard him because if you touched him, he’s going to act like he got shot out of a cannon.”

Latrell Sprewell on Reggie Miller, Aug 3, 2016. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Latrell Sprewell on Reggie Miller
item.description:
That included the Knicks upsetting both the Heat (Allan Houston’s shot) and Reggie Miller’s Pacers in the postseason.

“Reggie is a talker. The thing I hated about him is he was a flopper,”

Latrell Sprewell on Reggie Miller, Aug 3, 2016. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Chris Webber on Reggie Miller
item.description:
Webber, a former King, lamented players taking days off.

“I agree with [Miller] as far as the fact that the culture is different,”

Chris Webber on Reggie Miller, Apr 17, 2016. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Cedric Maxwell on Reggie Miller
item.description:
“If you’re talking about a great player wearing your number like a Reggie Miller, that makes the jersey even better,”

Cedric Maxwell on Reggie Miller, Aug 2, 2015. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: John Jenkins on Allan Houston, Reggie Miller
item.description:
(John) Jenkins said in reference to player comparisons.

“Reggie Miller and Allan Houston, those are two guys from back in the day that I look up to.”

John Jenkins on Allan Houston, Reggie Miller, Jun 15, 2012. Source: HoopsWorld.

item.title: Ray Allen on Reggie Miller
item.description:
Ray Allen on if Reggie Miller really wanted him to break his record:

“That is like the alter ego on the golf course when you hit a great shot or make a birdie and the real guy says, ‘Oh great shot’ but his alter ego comes out and he says, ‘Damn it!’”

Ray Allen on Reggie Miller, Feb 14, 2011. Source: Sports Radio Interviews.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Reggie Miller
item.description:
He did the rare thing: He retired when he was still an outstanding player, and he couldn’t be lured back when Mark Jackson and Garnett were working out with him, telling him he still could make a difference.

“I knew Reggie wouldn’t do it unless he felt he could still contribute,”

Danny Ainge on Reggie Miller, Feb 9, 2011. Source: Yahoo! Sports.
